transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Apple brings 18 artificial intelligence features to China with Alibaba's Qwen. Reported by FourWeekMBA: testing starts November 4, with public release in December via iOS 27.3.
Apple Intelligence launches in China in December with Qwen integration on iPhone 16 and later models. The Apple Post reported this development.
Nvidia is in talks to guarantee debt for Nscale's West Virginia data centre. Reported by The Next Web.
GPT-6.1 Sol beats Claude in artificial intelligence games through aggressive strategy and deep team coordination. BigGo Finance reported this outcome.
OpenAI doubles usage limits for Pro plans after user backlash, effective October 29, 2026. صوت الإمارات reported this change.
Free every hour.
